title: Facilities Management Officer (I) (Gen to 2ndLt) FMOS, DC I&L
raw_text:
3.     MOS 1330, Facilities Management Officer (I) (Gen to 2ndLt) FMOS, DC I&L

    a. Summary. Facilities Management Officers assist commanders in
carrying out their responsibilities to obtain, maintain, and operate
facilities needed for mission accomplishment. Responsibilities at the
installation level include facilities maintenance planning, budgeting, and
execution with billets as facilities maintenance plans officer and facilities
maintenance officer (the latter position being the Maintenance Branch Head or



                                            1-79                     Enclosure (1)
 1113                                                               NAVMC 1200.1L



equivalent for a Marine Corps installation). Responsibilities at
Headquarters Marine Corps include plans and policy formulation for base
realignment and closure, real property maintenance activities, and family/
bachelor housing. This MOS may be assigned only as a non-PMOS by CMC (MM)
upon a request from the individual, with the concurrence of the MOS manager/
OccFld sponsor.

       b.   Prerequisites.    None.

       c.   Requirements

            (1) Completion of a minimum of 6 months in a facilities management
billet.

        (2) Complete the Marine Corps Facilities Management Course (A-4A-
0066, CDP 3001), Civil Engineer Corps Officers School (CECOS), Port Hueneme,
CA.

       d.   Duties.   None.

       e.   Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code

            (1) Administrative Services Managers 11-3011.

        (2) First-Line Supervisors/Managers of Mechanics, Installers and
Repairers 49-1011.

            (3) Construction Managers 11-9021.

       f.   Related Military Skill

            (1) Utilities Officer, 1120.

            (2) Combat Engineer Officer, 1302.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
